newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Bank Sarasin confident of good 1997.
newsitem.headline: Bank Sarasin confident of good 1997.

text.p: Swiss fund manager Bank Sarasin & Co said 1997 had started well and it was confident of a good result for the year after boosting net profit in 1996 by 15.7 percent.
"The new year has in any case begun very well," the bank said in a letter to shareholders.
It said international financial markets continued to gain strength.
"The widely held view that interest rate levels will stay low for now means we can expect business to remain lively," it said.

Chief executive Peter Merian, in the text of a speech released by the bank, said: "The sustained positive trend in international financial markets and our expanded base of business allow us to look confidently into the coming business year and expect another good result in 1997."
The bank earlier reported that 1996 net profit rose to 34.26 million Swiss francs from 29.62 million the year before.
